title: Senior Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
ECI is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid\-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
   

  

 At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
 **our commitment to empowering our employees around the world** 
 .
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are seeking an enthusiastic, personable, and qualified Senior Network Operation Center Engineer (Network Monitoring) to join our amazing team! In this role, you will be part of the Network Services Team (NOC) that provides 24x7 monitoring, operations, and support services.
   

  

 The Senior NOC Engineer – Network Monitoring will provide monitoring and troubleshooting of
 **network infrastructure devices** 
 for global customers, supporting LAN/WAN/Firewalls /SD\-WAN environments. While responding to Level 1 and 2 service tickets, you will work closely with the team to address complex network problems escalated by NOC engineers. You will be responsible for escalating issues to next\-level support and engaging third\-party vendors for any
 **network or connectivity impairments** 
 .
   

  

 This is an
 **onsite** 
 role.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Resolve level 1 and 2 network support cases, incidents, and work orders associated with routing, switching, WAN, SD\-WAN and firewall environments following ECI defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring clear communication.
* Resolve incidents and requests from centralized monitoring systems related to, but not limited to the following:
* Alarm validation and alert correlation
* Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching issues (VLAN, STP)
* WAN/MPLS/VPLS/Express Route/Internet circuit issues
* SD\-WAN related alerts (tunnel status, edge device health, policy issues)
* Connectivity issues, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization
* Firewall issues (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet — NAT, policies, sessions)
* Wireless network\-related issues (controllers, AP connectivity)
* Perform troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control process for performing changes such as PAN\-OS, IOS and Meraki upgrades, configuration changes, and SD\-WAN updates during approved maintenance windows.
* Incident Management via ServiceNow tool.
* Follow client escalation procedures and handle customer calls for diagnosing network\-related issues.
* Provide timely and accurate end\-to\-end support via phone, email, and ticketing documentation.
* Accurately document incidents, diagnostics, correlations, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage ISPs and vendors for circuit outages, latency, packet loss or bandwidth issues.
* Escalate outage events and network impairments to appropriate stakeholders when unresolved within SLA timelines.
* Monitor and track scheduled network maintenance activities, analyzing impact and ensuring alignment with approved windows.
* Coordinate with internal teams and respond to communications promptly.
* Act as an escalation point for NOC Engineers on network related issues.
* Produce reports such as RCA, investigation reports, and network health summaries.
* Provide training for new hires in lower roles on network troubleshooting and monitoring.
* Provide feedback for continuous improvement of NOC network operations.
* Ability to work on Major Incident Management (MIM) tickets (P1/P2\) for Network related issues.


**Who you are:**
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/computer science or related field.
* 5 years of relevant experience in network support \& monitoring.
* Minimum 2 years as a NOC Engineer in network operations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical network issues clearly.
* Strong prioritization and customer centric mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting skills: ability to identify and analyze network issues, traffic behavior and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask in a high\-volume NOC environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in high\-pressure situations.
* Highly self\-motivated and proactive.
* Willingness to work in 24x7x365 operational environment.
* Strong experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of:
* Routers and switches (Cisco or equivalent)
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet)
* Wireless LAN controllers and access networks
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
* Experience with routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* Experience with switching technologies: VLANs, STP, trunking
* Experience in WAN technologies: MPLS, Internet circuits, VPNs (IPSec, SSL)
* Hands\-on experience with SD\-WAN technologies and Firewalls such as:
* Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela) / VMware (Velocloud) / Fortinet / Palo Alto
* Monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, or similar SNMP\-based platforms
* Ticketing tools experience such as ServiceNow
* Basic packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark – preferred)
* Certifications/Training Recommendations: CCENT or CCNA or CCNP or PCNSE or training equivalent. Knowledge of TCP/IP, Cisco routing, switching technologies and ITIL Exposure


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Experience with Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM
* Experience with network monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ConnectWise Automate etc.)
* Knowledge of DNS and network\-related services
* Relevant advanced network certifications


 ECI’s culture is all about connection – connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and so much more! If you believe you would be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever,
 **we would like to hear from you!**
**Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!**

**About The Role**
 The IT\&D Sr. Manager \- E\-commerce will serve as a strategic partner across Commercial, Sales, Marketing, IT\&D, and Digital Commerce teams to accelerate ecommerce growth through data, analytics, and technology enablement. This role is responsible for leading omnichannel analytics initiatives, driving adoption of ecommerce technologies, and transforming complex digital commerce data into actionable business insights that improve performance across retailers, marketplaces, and direct\-to\-consumer channels. This role will proactively identify value\-based and strategically driven opportunities and risks to enable our ultimate objective of delivering insights which create value and drive the business forward \- whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance and adoption.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with analytical expertise to deliver scalable ecommerce technology solutions that support growth, digital shelf optimization, retail media effectiveness, customer engagement, and commercial decision\-making.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

 Strategy, Insights \& Business Impact
   

  

* Drive Omnichannel Growth: Define and execute the analytics strategy across major digital commerce channels (Amazon, Walmart, Target, etc.), translating shopper, media, and digital shelf data into actionable growth opportunities.
* Enable Data\-Driven Decisions: Partner with cross\-functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, RGM, Media) to build robust KPI frameworks, measurement standards, and automated reporting solutions.
* Champion Commerce Modernization: Lead the organization's digital transformation by integrating retail media, sales, and digital shelf data into a unified, AI\-enabled analytics ecosystem that elevates organizational data literacy.


 Agile Technology Delivery
   

  

* Own the Technology Roadmap: Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of scalable ecommerce technologies, from translating complex business requirements into technical user stories to managing sprint backlogs.
* Deliver Value at Scale: Collaborate with global IT\&D, engineering, and capability teams to deploy high\-quality e\-commerce capabilities on time and within budget.
* Maximize Adoption \& ROI: Drive the continuous improvement and active adoption of e\-commerce platforms across markets through feedback loops, training, and change management initiatives.


 Data Governance \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Ensure Data Excellence: Establish and enforce strict data quality, compliance, and governance standards in alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Build Scalable Data Foundations: Partner with data engineering to optimize data flows, streamline integration processes, and establish standardized data models.
* Collaborate in a Matrix Environment: Act as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between technical teams and local/regional business stakeholders to align priorities and clear project roadblocks.
* Manage Stakeholder Alignment: Influence and unite diverse, multi\-market stakeholders, communicating complex insights clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 Experience managing analytics products, business requirements, and cross\-functional project delivery in agile environments.
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to synthesize large datasets into meaningful business insights.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Databricks, Azure, Google Analytics, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Proven experience with business/digital and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modelling, verification and methodology development
* Understanding of Data Engineering and BI technologies to work effectively and cooperatively with the product development teams
* Strong track record of contributing to projects and achieving results
* Experience in managing indirect report/s and working in a team oriented, collaborative environment


 Critical experience for role (approx. 3\):
   

  

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital commerce, business analytics, sales analytics, or related commercial analytics roles.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce business models, omnichannel commerce, retail media, and digital shelf analytics.
* Experience working with ecommerce and syndicated data sources such as Amazon Vendor/Seller Central, Walmart Luminate, retailer POS data, NielsenIQ, Circana/IRI, Profitero, Pacvue, or similar platforms.


 Preferred experience for role:
   

  

* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

 Product Development, system development, Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, Process Automisation, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Media Analytics, advertising, Consumer Engagement, Market Value, Market Chain, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.  **You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Delivering technical consultation and optimized electrification solutions by analyzing customer requirements, reviewing specifications, and defining clear scopes with transparent cost and responsibility mapping.
* Preparing comprehensive techno\-commercial proposals including bill of quantities, cost estimation, and competitive bid strategies while identifying and managing commercial, technical, and contractual risks.
* Collaborating with engineering, service, vendors, and product units to develop value\-driven proposals and support sales growth through technical presentations, workshops, and customer problem resolution.
* Driving customer engagement and pre\-sales activities to acquire orders, improve profitability, and achieve key performance metrics including order intake, Net Price Variance (NPV), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Ensuring achievement of business objectives including revenue growth, volume targets, and profitable expansion across assigned product portfolios, industries, and geographic markets.

* Extensive expertise in Electrical Power Distribution Systems, including HV Substations (AIS \& GIS), MV \& LT Switchgear, Intelligent MCCs, Transformers, Busducts, Battery Chargers, Cable Management Systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Extensive knowledge of motor and drive sizing, selection, and application engineering for process industry requirements, particularly in mining equipment, metals processing plants, profile mills, cement plants, and paper manufacturing facilities.

Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity, the leader in AI\-powered data security, is seeking an exceptional Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer to join our team in India . This is a high\-impact senior role designed for elite candidates who serve as trusted technical advisors capable of engaging at the CTO/CIO/CISO level. You will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of Cohesity’s cutting\-edge data security and data management solutions across India top enterprises Telco, BFSI, Pharma, Federal.
   

  

 As a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer, you will leverage your deep expertise in data protection, including enterprise backup and recovery solutions like Cohesity DataProtect and NetBackup, along with strong knowledge of cybersecurity, enterprise storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS). Experience with emerging AI/ML technologies in the context of data management or security is a plus. You will harness Cohesity’s expanded post\-merger portfolio – spanning data security, modern backup and recovery, cloud\-native protection, ransomware recovery, cyber resilience, and AI\-powered data management – to solve complex IT challenges and deliver unparalleled value to customers. We also expect you to bring a strong network and credibility within the India tech market, leveraging your relationships and reputation as a go\-to expert to accelerate Cohesity’s growth.

Serve as a high\-level technical consultant who can speak peer\-to\-peer with C\-level stakeholders and instil confidence in Cohesity’s vision.

* Excellent copywriting and communication skills.

* Strong understanding of brand voice, storytelling, and audience behaviour.
* Good research, analytical, presentation, and organisational skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with creative and account management teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach.

Good to Have

* Experience working with lifestyle, F\&B, hospitality, fashion, or consumer brands.

* Experience developing campaign concepts and integrated digital campaigns.
* Experience handling client presentations and meetings.

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.
   

  

 More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.
   

  

 Sonatype is privileged to work with customers who rely on us to improve the quality, security, and speed of their software development lifecycle. Customer Success at Sonatype is outcomes\-driven, technically credible, and growth oriented.
   

  

 As an Associate Customer Success Manager, you will engage a portfolio of customers through a scaled engagement model, using structured lifecycle motions and data signals to prioritize the right outreach at the right time. Your goal is to accelerate time\-to\-value, drive adoption and measurable outcomes, increase renewal confidence, and surface growth opportunities in partnership with the broader account team.
   

  

 This role is not intended to be reactive “shadow support.” You will be expected to deliver proactive, outcomes\-driven guidance—knowing when to pull in deeper subject matter expertise—while maintaining disciplined execution and consistent customer leadership.
   

  

 A defining expectation of this role is reflexive GenAI usage. You are expected to use GenAI tools as a thought partner to improve the quality, clarity, and strategic rigor of your analysis, planning, and communication—while validating outputs and applying sound judgment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Outcomes and Value Realization
   

  

* Lead structured customer motions to accelerate onboarding success, adoption, and time\-to\-value.

 Scaled Engagement and Signal\-Driven Execution

 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high\-touch, mission\-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands\-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.
 



 You will work on real\-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.

 Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols \- FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.

 Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.

 Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
* **Networking:** 
 Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.

 Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer\-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.



**Preferred Skills**

**How You Work** 



* You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high\-pressure customer conversations.
* You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
* You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
* You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
* You work well with distributed, cross\-functional teams across time zones.

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Finance \& Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with F\&S and Business Leaders to drive the long\-term success of Stripe
* Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data
* Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor
* Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments
* Define metrics and leading indicators of business performance and partner with the Analytics team to develop tools and dashboards to make these metrics widely accessible across Stripe


 Who you are
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 7–14 years of experience in a relevant analytical or finance role
* Intermediate (at a minimum) or advanced knowledge of SQL or Python is required \- you must be well versed working with extremely large and complex datasets \+ extracting insights
* Experience with financial analysis, financial forecasting, BvA (variance analysis), and other financial concepts
* Experience working on ambiguous problems and driving solutions/projects independently
* Ability to automate and use AI to streamline recurring tasks/analyses, in order to free up time to work on more strategic and higher impact work
* Experience building dashboards and data visualization tools from scratch
* A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners and department leads. You are seen as a trusted and objective advisor
* An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality
* A proven ability to be a self\-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
* Experience working in a global capacity (this team will work will all regions)


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience in a strategic finance function at a high\-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space
   

  

 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

About the Employer


JPMorgan Chase \& Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $3\.4 trillion and operations worldwide, serving millions of consumers and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Global Finance \& Business Management (GF\&BM) India is part of the firm's global capability center and the Office of the CFO, supporting the Finance function responsible for quarterly earnings reporting, regulatory compliance and capital management. Established in 2002, GF\&BM India has over 3,400 professionals across Mumbai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad, supporting four key pillars of work aligned to major lines of business including Corporate \& Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Consumer \& Community Banking, Asset \& Wealth Management and Corporate/Firmwide functions. The scale and diversity of GF\&BM India offer extensive opportunities to learn, grow and build a long\-term career within a strong, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and promotes continuous improvement, and this role is within the Consumer Banking Finance team in Bangalore, part of the Banking and Wealth Management line of business.


As a Financial Planning \& Analysis Analyst in the Consumer Banking Finance team in Bangalore, you will be responsible for partnering across the firm to provide financial and strategic analysis, oversight, and coordination of budgeting and forecasting.




Job Responsibilities

* Calculation and consolidation of the month\-end results, the forecast for the remainder of the year, and the budget for future years
* Perform variance analysis to understand the key drivers of the results and provide commentary explaining changes from prior forecasts/budgets
* Produce weekly/monthly/quarterly and adhoc reporting of the results and drivers for senior management
* Enhance controls and streamline processes, introducing automation where possible
* Work on projects to drive global consistency and create synergies across the team


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills


* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a subject of a technical nature
* With two years of experience in Finance domain preferably FP\&A
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint
* Inquisitive, enthusiastic and diligent, and capable of challenging peers
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly
* Highly motivated and able to thrive and think clearly under pressure and tight deadlines
* Integrity in handling highly sensitive and confidential information
* Team player with the ability to be respected as a trusted partner for the Business, Finance, and FP\&A Teams


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

The Client Incentive Operations team are responsible for managing Client Incentive and Merchant Acceptance Incentive agreements. description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Senior Consultant \- CRM and Sales Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Senior Consultant \- CRM and Sales Transformation will support CRM and sales transformation initiatives within the Customer \- MSS practice. This role combines CRM process design, sales effectiveness improvement, requirements structuring, delivery support, and stakeholder coordination. You will work with client teams to assess current\-state sales and CRM processes, identify improvement opportunities, support solution design, and help implement CRM\-enabled workflows that improve pipeline discipline, customer engagement, forecasting quality, and sales productivity.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support CRM and sales transformation pursuits by contributing to proposals, RFP responses, client discussion materials, and solution narratives.
+ Conduct secondary research, benchmark analysis, and market scan activities to support CRM modernization and sales effectiveness offerings.
+ Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, playbooks, and point\-of\-view materials on CRM adoption, sales process standardization, and digital selling enablement.
+ Support preparation of executive presentations, workshop materials, and client\-facing deliverables to communicate transformation opportunities and recommendations.
+ Keep abreast of CRM platform capabilities, AI\-enabled sales insights, sales enablement tools, and evolving customer engagement models that may affect client growth priorities.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Support CRM and sales transformation engagements from current\-state assessment through design, implementation planning, adoption support, and benefits tracking.
+ Assess sales processes, CRM usage, data quality, lead management, opportunity management, account planning, pipeline governance, forecasting, and performance reporting practices.
+ Document business requirements, process flows, user stories, functional specifications, operating model components, and adoption considerations for CRM\-enabled transformation initiatives.
+ Support design of CRM workflows, sales process frameworks, dashboards, governance routines, role definitions, and performance management mechanisms.
+ Work with sales, marketing, service, technology, and data teams to translate business priorities into structured delivery inputs and implementation\-ready artefacts.
+ Support CRM adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, training inputs, change impact documentation, communications support, and adoption tracking.
+ Contribute to business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, conversion improvement, forecast accuracy improvement, revenue uplift, and cost\-to\-sell reduction.
+ Track project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and actions to support delivery excellence across scope, timeline, and quality expectations.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Support teams in leveraging CRM platforms, workflow automation, sales analytics, sales enablement tools, customer data platforms, and AI\-enabled insights to improve sales effectiveness.
+ Assist in defining data, reporting, integration, and adoption considerations for CRM\-enabled sales transformation initiatives.
+ Identify opportunities to use accelerators, templates, analytics, and automation to improve discovery, solution design, requirements readiness, and delivery governance.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Coordinate with consultants, analysts, and cross\-functional teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables and high\-quality project execution.
+ Support knowledge sharing, team enablement, and coaching of junior team members on CRM transformation methods, requirements documentation, and structured problem solving.
+ Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
+ Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of CRM and sales transformation capabilities, including operating model design, adoption strategy, sales governance, territory planning, incentive effectiveness, and pipeline optimization.
* Have experience leveraging AI\-driven sales capabilities, including lead scoring, next\-best\-action recommendations, customer 360 insights, and advanced sales performance analytics.
* Have exposure to leading CRM platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Sales Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, HubSpot, Oracle CX, SAP Sales Cloud, and similar technologies.
* Bring experience delivering transformation initiatives across industries such as professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer products, healthcare, financial services, or other B2B sectors.


**What We Look For**
* 5\+ years of experience in CRM transformation, sales transformation, commercial excellence, sales operations, customer engagement transformation, or digital transformation.
* Consulting experience is desired
* Experience supporting CRM\-enabled transformation programs, sales process improvement initiatives, CRM adoption activities, or sales performance improvement projects.
* Strong understanding of lead management, opportunity management, pipeline governance, account planning, forecasting, customer data, and sales performance metrics.
* Hands\-on exposure to CRM platforms, sales analytics, workflow automation, sales enablement tools, or sales process redesign.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and project management skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
 Serves as a point of contact for customers, fielding inquiries via phone or electronic channels. Provides technical support by troubleshooting and resolving simple issues encountered with assigned Oracle product(s). Coordinates with more experienced peers to report and support the resolution of routine design, reliability, and maintenance issues. Maintains service request and/or product documentation and learns to create Knowledge Base articles and/or troubleshooting guides for resolving issues. Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues. Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support and Solution Delivery\-Customer Support and Advocacy:**
* Serves as a point of contact for customers and facilitates customer relationship building, fielding inquiries via phone, electronic, or in\-person means.
* Provides technical support to customers by answering technical questions, troubleshooting and resolving simple issues related to assigned Oracle product(s).


**Technical Support and Solution Delivery\-Technical Problem\-Solving and Resolution:**
* Leverages basic understanding of problem resolution, which may include fix delivery and product certification to research, re\-create, and test technical issues for assigned product area(s) reported by customers to identify a resolution, with minimal guidance.
* Follows up with customer on service request(s) to communicate resolution and ensure all issues are resolved, escalating complex customer technical issues to appropriate technical teams for resolution, as needed.
* Coordinates with more experienced peers to report design, reliability, and maintenance problems or bugs, supporting resolution of routine issues through roll\-up.


**Technical Support and Solution Delivery\-Technical Support Documentation:**
* Documents activities on service request and/or product documentation, learning to leverage troubleshooting guides and/or Knowledge Base articles, through resolution.
* Learns to prepare troubleshooting guides and/or create Knowledge Base articles for resolved issues.


**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement\-Technical Support Collaboration:**
* Begins to develop a deeper understanding of assigned Oracle product ecosystem(s) and customer environment(s).
* Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues.


**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement\-Technical Support Improvement:**
* Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues.
* Begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices, based on customer feedback and/or operational insights.


**Performance Monitoring and Management:**
* Monitors and executes own support service performance metrics, with some guidance.


**Additional Responsibilities (as Needed)**
**Services Translation:**
* Provides translation oral and verbal services for technical and non\-technical inquiries for products and services, with guidance.


**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning \& Execution:**
* Completes assigned tasks and monitors timelines to ensure timely completion of work in accordance with project requirements, with supervision. Follows direction to prioritize work and adjust to shifts in resources or timelines.


**Collaboration \& Partnership:**
* Collaborates with team members to better understand expectations and contribute to shared objectives. Builds basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Specialist III, Data Scientist**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

 EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads and executes deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data\-driven business decision making, while mentoring junior data scientists and analysts, and applying advanced data science and big data mining techniques to uncover trends, inform strategic initiatives, and drive innovation across diverse business functions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develops complex queries and performs extensive programming to access, transform, and prepare data for statistical modeling.
* Leads and executes deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data\-driven business decision making. Mentors and develops junior data scientists and analysts.
* Identifies and diagnoses data inconsistencies and errors, documents data assumptions, and forages to fill data gaps.
* Engages with internal stakeholders to understand and probe business processes in order to develop hypotheses. Brings structure to requests and translates requirements into an analytic approach.
* Guides test design, research design, and model validation. Provides statistical consultation services. Serves as the analytics expert on cross functional teams for large strategic initiatives and contributes to the growth of the analytic community.
* Prepares and delivers insight presentations and action recommendations. Communicates complex analytical findings and implications to business leaders.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Designs scalable data mining models and reporting protocols to identify trends and patterns in massive datasets.
* Applies modern and emerging data science techniques to solve business problems across functions such as marketing, economics, and operations.
* Contributes to the advancement of analytics through exploratory research and application of cutting\-edge statistical theory.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in data science, predictive analytics, or advanced statistical modeling roles

**Responsibilities**
**General Position Requirements / Scope**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Campaign Operations Analyst** 
 to join our Lifecycle Marketing team. You bring 3–5 years of hands\-on campaign execution experience and are equally comfortable configuring journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer as you are writing SQL to validate the data underneath them. You operate independently, take full ownership of your campaigns from build through deployment, and hold yourself to a high bar for data accuracy and operational quality. This is a technical, execution\-focused role on a team that moves fast and values precision.
   

  

**Campaign Build \& Execution**
* Independently own the full lifecycle of multi\-channel campaign builds in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — including journey design, message authoring, audience assignment, suppression logic, scheduling, and deployment across email, push, SMS, and in\-app channels.
* Configure and manage audience segments in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) using the segment builder, applying complex behavioral, event\-based, demographic, and product\-usage criteria to meet campaign targeting requirements.
* Execute rigorous pre\-send QA covering content accuracy, link validation, dynamic personalization, audience sizing, suppression integrity, frequency cap compliance, and regulatory opt\-out checks.
* Manage a concurrent portfolio of campaigns across multiple marketing programs, consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* Monitor live journeys and scheduled sends for performance and execution health, identifying and resolving issues in real time.
* Collaborate with Marketing strategists and Creative teams to translate campaign briefs into technically precise execution plans, raising data or platform feasibility concerns early.


**SQL \& Data Validation**
* Write proficient, independent SQL against BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalent cloud data warehouses to validate audience logic, verify segment membership, confirm suppression accuracy, and size eligibility pools ahead of every campaign.
* Use SQL to diagnose and resolve data discrepancies — including mismatched counts between AEP segments and source tables, unexpected audience fluctuations, profile attribute gaps, and ingestion anomalies.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable SQL scripts for recurring campaign validation tasks: deduplication checks, holdout group verification, frequency analysis, and eligibility audits.
* Conduct post\-campaign data pulls to support performance reporting, holdout measurement, deliverability analysis, and data reconciliation between AJO send logs and source systems.
* Partner with Data Engineering to surface upstream data quality issues with query\-backed evidence, clearly articulating the business impact on campaign audiences.
* Validate AEP dataset ingestion completeness and profile attribute accuracy using SQL, flagging pipeline gaps that could affect targeting before they reach production.


**Platform Operations \& Governance**
* Apply and enforce campaign governance standards across all builds: naming conventions, folder organization, tagging taxonomies, consent and compliance controls, and change management procedures.
* Monitor AEP data ingestion pipelines and AJO journey execution health, proactively identifying anomalies that could degrade campaign performance or data quality.
* Contribute to platform configuration work including A/B test setup, template management, suppression list maintenance, and segment catalog hygiene.
* Assist in evaluating new AJO and AEP platform capabilities, providing operational perspective on feasibility and implementation requirements.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Act as the primary liaison between Marketing, Marketing Technology, and Data Engineering, on campaign operations topics.


**Required**
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in campaign operations, marketing technology, or a closely related technical role.
* Proficient, production\-level SQL skills — you independently write complex queries involving JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and subqueries to solve real data problems without assistance or templates.
* Proven hands\-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — you have independently built, QA'd, and deployed journeys across multiple channels in a professional environment.
* Solid working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — including segment builder, XDM schema structure, profile attributes, dataset management, and identity resolution concepts.
* Direct experience querying cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks as part of regular campaign operations work.
* Strong QA instincts and a systematic approach to verifying data accuracy before every send.
* Ability to manage a concurrent workload of campaigns across multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
* Clear, confident communicator — able to present data findings, raise platform concerns, and explain technical details to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred**
* Deep familiarity with AEP data ops: ADLS ingestion pipelines, AJO journey execution monitoring, segment evaluation jobs, and profile snapshot audits.
* Experience with additional Adobe Experience Cloud tools such as Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target.
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template QA, rendering troubleshooting, and minor template edits.
* Solid understanding of email deliverability principles and marketing compliance requirements (CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience with BI or analytics tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with dbt or data modeling concepts as they relate to marketing audience tables.


 Experience working in agile environments with sprint\-based delivery and ticket\-driven workflows.

 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with tools and infrastructure development to optimize the software engineering process and passion for engineering excellence.

**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
   

  

 The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

* Foster a culture of collaboration and partnership by working closely with engineering teams across Google One and Photos to ensure seamless execution and alignment with our objectives.

* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, articulating technical concepts, and influencing decisions to drive the success of projects.

**Job Title: AI/ML Engineer – Automotive Data, DevOps \& Developer Productivity**
 We are looking for an

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work on end\-to\-end model lifecycle activities including training, evaluation, deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.
* Collaborate with software, data, validation, and platform teams to integrate AI/ML components into production systems.

**Introduction**

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 About the Role:
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the \[1] Tableflow team. In this role, you will build the critical components that turn Confluent Cloud data streams into open table formats. You will bridge the gap between operational streaming (Kafka) and analytical data lakes (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) by building the control plane and data plane components that materialize topics into tables in real\-time.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a team of passionate engineers who love solving complex distributed systems and infrastructure problems. The Tableflow team creates the "intelligent connective tissue" between Confluent’s data streaming platform and the modern data lakehouse. The team’s work focuses on two core pillars:
   

  

 Control Plane: Building the robust orchestration layer that manages the entire lifecycle of tables across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
   

  

 Open Table Formats and Ecosystem: Building the translation logic to publish Kafka data as Tables (Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake) and also integrates with the Lakehouse ecosystem (AWS Glue, Unity Catalog).
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Design and implement data plane components that publish data into open\-table formats and integrate with the ecosystem.
   

  

 Develop control plane services and APIs that orchestrate table lifecycles and resource management.
   

  

 Contribute to relevant open\-Source projects such as Apache Iceberg.
   

  

 Own code quality, test coverage, documentation, and maintainability for your components.
   

  

 Drive technical designs, leading discussions to curate and moderate decisions with stakeholders.
   

  

 Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to deliver complex features.
   

  

 Lead operational excellence by resolving high\-severity incidents, building observability tools, and designing automated workflows to ensure 99\.99% availability.
   

  

 Be an active team player by leading meetings, taking initiative, and participating in on\-call rotations.
   

  

 References
   

  

 Visible links
   

  

* https://www.confluent.io/product/tableflow/

 Master's Degree

* Self starter who is able to quickly ramp up on the important bits of our overall product.
* Good understanding of distributed systems design and development.
* Experience running production services, debugging complex integration issues, and driving post\-mortems.
* Ability to move fast and iterate with a sense of urgency while delivering results without surprises.
* A growth mindset and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and take on customer problems.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Experience using and/or working on data infrastructure such as SQL databases, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink or Apache Spark.
* Hands\-on experience with Open\-Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake) and Data Catalogs (Unity Catalog or AWS Glue).

Overview:

The Electrical Engineer supports the design and execution of electrical engineering projects under the guidance of senior engineers and managers. The role involves applying engineering fundamentals, preparing high\-quality design deliverables, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams, and helping ensure projects are completed on schedule and within budget. The engineer will also demonstrate leadership by providing technical guidance, mentoring junior engineers and designers, reviewing their work, and supporting their professional development.
The engineer will contribute to U.S.\-based tool installation projects across industries such as automotive manufacturing, battery manufacturing, semiconductor facilities, and related industrial environments.
AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities*** **Perform a variety of electrical engineering assignments as listed below with increasing levels of responsibility based on demonstrated performance and technical proficiency.**
* + **Design \& Calculations: Prepare load lists, single\-line diagrams (SLDs), and power layouts. Perform equipment sizing, conductor sizing, voltage drop, SCC and conduit/tray fill calculations, earthing \& bonding, lighting calculations using NEC/NFPA 70 standards and local requirements.**
	+ **Power System Studies: Support modeling and analysis in SKM / Easypower (Load Flow, Short Circuit, Coordination, and Arc Flash).**
	+ **Drafting \& Coordination: Prepare 2D/3D deliverables in Revit. Coordinate with Mechanical, Structural, and Architectural disciplines to resolve clashes.**
	+ **Documentation: Assist with technical specifications and responding to RFIs.**
* **The Electrical Tool Installation Engineer will develop comprehensive electrical design packages for semiconductor tool installations, including schematics, facility data, routing plans, elevations, and installation details. The role requires superior technical expertise, effective multidisciplinary coordination, and strict compliance with applicable codes, client standards, and quality requirements. The Electrical Tool Installation Engineer will perform following tasks.**
* **Develop electrical tool installation packages, including schematics, facility data, Fab/Subfab routing plans, elevations, and custom installation details.**
* **Design normal, emergency, UPS, primary, secondary, and low\-voltage power distribution systems with an emphasis on reliability and redundancy.**
* **Size circuits, conductors, conduits, cable trays, wireways, grounding conductors, and excess cable storage boxes.**
* **Perform electrical calculations, including panel loading, ampacity, voltage drop, short\-circuit current, breaker AIC, overcurrent protection, cable tray fill, raceway fill, grounding, bonding, and conductor bending requirements.**
* **Evaluate equipment terminal provisions, cable insulation ratings, circuit classifications, NEC separation requirements, electrical clearances, and short\-circuit current ratings.**
* **Perform arc\-flash evaluations and develop design solutions to reduce AF PPE levels where required.**
* **Coordinate design requirements with engineers, local designers, suppliers, and Architectural, Mechanical, and Structural disciplines.**
* **Review calculations and drawings, respond to RFIs, incorporate field changes, and prepare record drawings.**
* **Maintain quality by complying with project, team, design, and CAD standards.**
* **Provide technical guidance, coaching, and development support to local designers.**
* **Travel as required for initial training and project coordination.**

**Work timings– Morning 08\.00am to 12noon IST and evening 08\.00pm to 12:00am IST.**
Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications*** **Full\-time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.**
* **Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals and design principles.**
* **Proficiency in engineering design and drafting software, including CAD platforms.**
* **Ability to prepare engineering calculations, drawings, and technical documentation.**
* **Strong analytical, problem\-solving, learning and organizational skills.**
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills.**
* **Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.**
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and standard engineering software tools.**

**Preferred Qualifications*** **Experience with industrial, semiconductor, automotive, manufacturing, or commercial building projects.**
* **Familiarity with Revit, BIM workflows, and related engineering software.**
* **Knowledge of applicable electrical codes, standards, and industry best practices.**

**Key Competencies*** **Technical aptitude and attention to detail.**
* **Effective communication and collaboration skills.**
* **Initiative and willingness to learn and grow professionally.**
* **Time management and ability to meet project deadlines.**
* **Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.**

 **Additional Perks Offered:*** **Compensation\- as per industry standards.**
* **A collaborative and supportive culture where you’re not just a number—you’re a critical and highly valued member of our team!**
* **Hybrid / remote work arrangements.**
* **As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will experience exciting projects from start to finish and interface directly with some of the most forward\-thinking clients in the world.**
* **A mindset of continuous learning where you are encouraged to ask questions, bring fresh ideas to the table, and pursue your professional development goals.**
* **A diversity of market sectors, project types, and geographic locations that help insulate your career from economic ups and downs.**
* **A formal career path and real opportunities for advancement.**
* **A holistic approach to compensation and benefits that supports your physical and mental health, encourages work\-life balance, and empowers your career advancement and financial success.**

 **SSOE– The Best of Both Worlds** **At SSOE, our growth trajectory allows us to offer the opportunities normally associated with a large firm while embracing the collaborative and supportive culture often found in smaller firms. As a member of the SSOE team, you will work on exciting and diverse projects for Fortune 100 clients around the globe, supported by the best technology for the task at hand. You will experience our employee\-centric culture that strives to offer a healthy balance, flexible working arrangements, direct access to leadership at all levels, and a mindset of continuous learning. Once you experience the SSOE difference, you’ll understand the why behind our metrics:***

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

About You:
  

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  

  

About The Role:
  

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging \& complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  

  

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):  

  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co\-located and in\-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting \& managing relationships with external vendors \& contractors
* Liaising with internal teams \& management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health \& Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

  

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.  

  

People Management.
  

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high \& low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  

  

Incident Management.
  

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management \& Fault Management.
  

  

Vendor Management.
  

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors \& security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem \& conflict management when dealing with same.

 **data engineering depth** 
 , with the ability to build and integrate backend APIs and contribute to frontend integrations when needed. You will work across data, application, and AI layers to ship scalable systems end\-to\-end.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

**Data Engineering**
 Design and own ETL/ELT pipelines (batch and streaming where required).
   

  

 Drive Medallion architecture design (Bronze, Silver, Gold) with clear data contracts and quality checks.

Define evaluation metrics for retrieval quality, hallucination reduction, and latency. Contribute to architecture decisions around AI services and integration patterns.
   

  

 Backend s Full\-Stack Contributions
   

  

 Design and implement backend APIs (FastAPI or similar frameworks). Build microservices to expose data products and AI capabilities.

 Collaborate with frontend teams to ensure data contracts and performance alignment.
   

  

 Must Have
   

  

 3–5 years’ experience in Data Engineering / Backend Engineering. Strong Python and advanced SQL skills.
   

  

 Hands\-on Spark/Databricks experience with performance optimization.
   

  

 Deep understanding of Medallion architecture and production data systems. Experience building reliable data pipelines with testing and monitoring.
   

  

 Practical understanding of LLMs, RAG systems, embeddings, vector search. Experience building and deploying REST APIs.
   

  

 Understanding of system design basics (scalability, reliability, trade\-offs).
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

 Frontend exposure (React/Angular or similar).
   

  

 Experience with API gateways and microservices architecture. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker). Experience with evaluation frameworks for GenAI systems.
   

  

 Knowledge of cost optimization in cloud\-based data platforms.
   

  

 Tech Stack
   

  

 Python, SQL, Spark/Databricks, Delta Lake, orchestration tools, REST APIs (FastAPI), vector search systems, LLM APIs, Git, CI/CD, monitoring/logging, basic frontend frameworks.
   

  

 Success Looks Like
   

  

 You independently design and ship production\-grade pipelines.
   

  

 You improve RAG quality through measurable retrieval and prompt improvements. You build backend services that are scalable, observable, and secure.
   

  

 You reduce data defects through better modeling and validation practices.
   

  

 You proactively identify foundational gaps and address them before feature work scales.
   

  

 Experience That Stands Out
   

  

 Built and maintained a multi\-layer medallion architecture at scale.
   

  

 Designed and deployed a production RAG system with measurable evaluation. Built backend APIs serving AI/data features consumed by frontend apps.
   

  

 Improved system performance through Spark optimization or query tuning. Contributed to cross\-team architectural improvements.
