**Role : SME Sales Executive**

**Location :** MG Road, Bangalore (In\-House)  
**Reporting to :** SME Sales Lead (UK) / SME Sales Shift Lead  
**Markets Covered:** US\-Canada  
**Tools Used :** Zendesk (calls, tickets), Calendly, Company Platform

**About the** Company is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  
Our platform uses cutting\-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. We're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription\-based pricing.  
As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Company offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast\-moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025\) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026\. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**Role Overview**

The **SME Sales Executive** is a front\-line sales role responsible for engaging small and medium\-sized businesses (SMEs) who have shown interest in Company’s platform. This role combines **outbound cold calling**, **live selling and activation**, and **onboarding conversations** to help sellers start winning work through Company.

Sales Executives will speak to business owners across global English\-speaking markets, build trust quickly, clearly explain Company’s value, and guide sellers toward either booking an onboarding session or activating directly on the call.

This role requires confidence on the phone, strong communication skills, resilience, and the ability to follow structured sales processes while delivering a high\-quality seller experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Outbound Sales \& Cold Calling**

· Make high\-volume outbound calls to sellers using Zendesk

· Engage new and lapsed sellers through structured cold\-calling frameworks

· Confidently explain Company’s value proposition (for both lead\-gen and marketplace model)

· Handle common objections and move conversations forward.

· Determine whether the best next step is:

o Booking an onboarding meeting, or

o Activating and selling on the call

**Meeting Booking \& Scheduling**

· Book onboarding or follow\-up meetings using Calendly.

· Guide sellers through availability using simple, conversational questions:

o “Which day works best for you?”

o “Morning or afternoon?”

· Confirm meeting details clearly and professionally.

· Send follow\-up emails with Calendly links when sellers cannot commit immediately.

**Live Selling \& Seller Activation**

· Activate sellers directly on a call or during pre\-booked activation calls.

· Explain pricing, credits, lead flow, and value clearly and confidently.

· Help sellers select the right categories, locations, and lead settings.

· Ensure sellers understand best practices before purchasing leads.

· Maintain compliance with approved scripts, pricing, and offers.

**Onboarding Calls**

· Conduct onboarding calls with sellers who have already booked meetings.

· Walk sellers through:

o Activation and start pack options (if required)

o Profile setup

o Lead settings and filters

o Buying and responding to leads

o Best practices to maximise conversion

· Answer questions and remove friction during early platform usage.

· Deliver a positive, consultative seller experience.

**Systems, Process \& Data Accuracy**

· Accurately log all call outcomes, notes, and actions in Zendesk.

· Use correct dispositions for unanswered calls, voicemails, callbacks, and meetings booked.

· Follow outbound cadence rules (call attempts, voicemail, email follow\-ups).

· Adhere to compliance, quality, and communication standards.

**Key Skills \& Experience**

· 1–3 years’ experience in outbound sales, inside sales or customer support.

· Comfortable making cold calls to business owners and decision\-makers.

· Clear, neutral, and confident spoken English suitable for global markets.

· Strong objection\-handling and conversational selling skills.

· Ability to follow structured scripts while sounding natural and authentic.

· Comfortable using CRM or ticketing tools (Zendesk experience is a plus).

· Resilient, target\-driven, and comfortable handling rejection.

· Willingness to work aligned to US/UK business hours.

**Working Hours \& Availability**

· If supporting US\-Canada \- Shift 08:00 PM IST to 05:00AM IST

· If supporting UK\-Ireland \- Shift 12:30PM IST to 09:30PM IST

· If supporting Australia\-New Zealand \- Shift 05:00AM IST to 02:00PM IST  
**Perks and Benefits**

· Flexible working policy with India office located in CBD Bangalore

· Insurances \- Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life

· Personal annual L\&D Budgets to spend on your development

· **Cult.fit** membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes

· Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Quarterly All\-site Socials

· Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

**Interview Process**

· Screening with Talent Partner

· 1st Stage \- Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

· 2nd Stage \- Technical Task \& Interview (60 mins

3rd Stage \- Values interview (30 mins)

description:
Financial Analyst II  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Financial Analyst II at ICON, you will play a significant role in supporting advanced financial planning, analysis, and decision\-making processes.


**What You Will Do:**

Your role will involve delivering finance and financial management work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Conducting detailed financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business unit performance and strategic planning.
* Developing and maintaining complex financial models to evaluate business scenarios and support decision\-making processes.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to monitor and report on key financial and operational metrics.
* Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices in financial analysis and reporting.

**Your Profile:**

You will bring relevant finance and financial management experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
* 2\-4 years of experience in financial analysis or related roles, with a strong understanding of financial principles and practices.
* Advanced proficiency in financial modeling and analytical tools, such as Excel, with experience in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) being a plus.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as required (approximately 5%)
  

  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
 At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
   

  

**Information About The Business**
 Aon Captive \& Insurance Management (ACIM) team is involved in Financial Reporting and Commercial Insurance business, Operations \& Risk, Internal Finance \& Life Actuarial Support.
   

  

**General Description Of Role**
 Incumbent would be responsible for preparation of Financial Reporting, Planning and Budgeting, Forecasting, Management Information (MI) Reporting and Financial Controllership function.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* CA Fresher to 4 years of work experience into Finance \& Accounting, Planning and Budgeting, Forecasting, Management Information (MI) Reporting and Controlling function.
* Proven track of working with multiple clients and managing the deliverables under a fast changing expectations with accurate quality in a metrics environment.
* Experienced in working towards identifying and implementing the process improvements, standardization and automation impacting larger team.
* Preferably someone from an F \& A Off\-shoring background from Record to Report function, Management Reporting/Financial Reporting or Controllership.
* Preparation of Management Service Accounts (MSA) for the Captive Entities and ensuring the timely submission of MSAs with Notes and Schedules.
* Regular interaction with the Domicile team to timely collect the appropriate information/inputs; perform General and Technical Accounting and related calculations including Loss Reserves.
* Independently deliver the complex set of Management accounts for large clients with multiple risk coverage/policies based across geographies.
* Preparing the Financial Statements per US GAAP or IFRS\-17\.
* Support the Domiciles for Adhoc queries and Financial Audit.
* Develop good working relations with On\-shore clients by providing adequate customer service, and proactively work towards managing the customer expectations.
* Peer Review of Management Accounts, Schedules, and workings to testify the quality of deliverables, and assist in effectively implementing the Internal Review Mechanism and Control process.
* Actively work with supervisor and other team members in identifying and implementing the process standardization, simplification and automation opportunities, and act as a mentor/support for the junior team members.
* Work with the immediate supervisor for operations stabilization, and ability to act as a back\-up.


**Skills/Competencies Required**
* Hands on experience to any Accounting Software / ERP (SAP, Oracle, People Soft) added advantage if exposure to SICS, D365 \& E\-Frame (IFRS\-17\) is available.
* Good Knowledge of MS\-Office primarily MS\-Excel with ability to use the functions of Advanced Excel including developing Macros.
* Basic understanding of IFRS\-17 \& US\-GAAP
* Good Communication and Customer Service skills.
* Ability to deal with mid to senior stakeholders, and good articulation skills.
* At times, ability to convince the onshore customers with right reasoning and presentation of facts.
* Takes initiatives and self\-motivated.
* Disciplined and professional approach in delivering results, and ability to act as successor for the next role \& take up additional responsibilities.
* Works with the team members on assigned projects and deliverable.
* Collaborative and willingness to participate in wider initiatives.
* Good Finance and Accounting experience with Analytical skills,
* Ability to fast interpret \& analyze the numbers and calculate the impact on Financial Statements.
* Review and Procedural Controls.
* Strong Communication skill
* Small to large project teams and extensive interaction with internal and/or external clients.

**The Opportunity**
 Global Category Expert (Sr Analyst) are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments and have a strong bias for decision\-making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence Indirect Spend vendor relationships by advising senior leaders on innovative sourcing strategies that create sustainable, long\-term partnerships. They are highly effective communicators, able to articulate the value proposition that procurement can bring to their organizations. The role need to have hands on experience in supplier negotiations, auctions/advanced negotiation methods, Supplier relationship management, data analytics, Power BI, Usage of AI/Copilot in Sourcing activities (reporting, MS Tools etc.), creating Power BI , SAP, Category Strategy , Knowledge of Vendor market ,Willing to start from scratch, Knowledge of Indirect \& Economic Megatrends etc.
   

  

**MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (List in order of importance)**
**Strategic Sourcing**
* The role will be responsible as a seasoned category buyer who can handle Supplier negotiations, Contract Management, Supplier mentorships, Supplier relationship management, S2C , Stake Holder Management , Risk Management \& Category Management.
* Market research for Indirect commodities, can handle Global subcategories individually.
* Basic understanding of SaaS/on\-prem licensing models
* Basic literacy on existing software landscape and trends
* Eagerness to learn more about IT trends in modern corporate environment
* Responsible for market assessments, prequalification, and RFQ processes
* Issue inquiries (RFQ), evaluate received quotation and negotiate commercial terms. Select the most appropriate suppliers, through the definition and analysis of objective criteria, to meet the needs of the business.
* Achieve systematic and sustainable cost reductions through strengthened spend and category management processes.
* Manage and run renegotiations with relevant suppliers for any contract renewals.
* Manage supplier relations, monitor performance, initiate and follow up supplier development activities and improvements.
* Maintain contract archive system.
* Ensure compliance with company guidelines, purchasing policies and procedures.
* In cooperation with the global category manager identify new areas for improvements, identify cost reduction.
* Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench\-marking analysis.
* Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, auctions, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
* Process requests as per requirement – meet and exceed KPIs defined/set parameters.
* Deliver tasks as per Service Level requirements specified by the Business Unit/Center/Stakeholder.
* Upskill process knowledge from time to time.
* Able to work in a team – understand role in team \- help accomplish team goals and objectives – meet and exceed stakeholder objectives/goals
* Developing, implementing and managing robust market analyses / bench\-marking processes; leveraging key\-insights to inform and support the category strategy development process.


**Business Partnering**
* Partner with leadership teams in exploring \& identification of cost saving opportunities.
* Identifying the opportunities of centralized sourcing in place of standalone sourcing and avoiding the maverick spend.
* Establishing strong relationships with internal business stakeholders; building a strong understanding of strategic business direction, requirements and priorities across assigned suppliers and/or spend categories.
* Uphold VWR Culture, Values at all times
* Willingness to work in any shift
* Flexibility for any lateral movement amongst the various Business Functions
* Working with business and finance colleagues to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership.
* Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement strategies; maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Avantor’s global policies.
* Act as Finance Business Partner for indirect sourcing Operations team, understanding the key priorities of business/function and providing insights with forward\-looking analysis on indirect spend. Initiate discussions/reviews with business partners to enable them in taking key business decisions.
* Understanding \& Providing In\-depth analysis of indirect spend analytics at global level by supplier, region, categories, and by other types using AFO,SAP \& QlikView etc. Identifying \& proposing productivity opportunities.

description:
**About Us**
 We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

**About Global Business Services**
 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Internal Audit Manager – Operations \& Quality Assurance within Reckitt’s Global Internal Audit Centre of Excellence, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping best‑in‑class audit delivery, strengthening methodology, and driving continuous improvement across the global audit function. Reporting to the Head of the COE, you will oversee global audit operations, lead the function’s Quality Assurance programme, and ensure consistent application of audit standards, practices, and tools.
   

  

 You will directly manage a diverse team of audit delivery, data analytics, and IT\&D professionals, building capability and embedding progressive ways of working. You will also collaborate closely with Audit Leaders and Domain Leads to enhance execution quality, drive operational excellence, and contribute to the digital enablement of the audit function. This is a highly visible role, central to ensuring that Internal Audit delivers impactful, value‑adding assurance across all regions and processes.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Oversee day\-to\-day Internal Audit operations, ensuring effective planning, resourcing, and delivery.
* Maintain and enhance audit methodologies, templates, standards, and governance processes.
* Support annual audit planning, resource management, portfolio oversight, and performance reporting.
* Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor audit progress, quality, and operational metrics.
* Partner with Data Analytics teams to drive digital enablement and operational efficiency.
* Lead the Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program, ensuring compliance with audit methodology and standards.
* Conduct quality reviews and provide feedback to strengthen audit effectiveness and consistency.
* Support external assessments and continuous improvement initiatives across the audit function.
* Analyze quality trends, root causes, and performance insights to drive improvement actions.
* Lead, coach, and develop audit, data analytics, and IT\&D team members within the COE.
* Support onboarding, training, capability building, and professional development programs.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Partner with Audit Leaders, Domain Leads, and stakeholders to ensure consistent audit delivery.
* Communicate operational insights, QA outcomes, and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management and audit committee reporting with relevant performance and quality metrics.
* Drive adoption of analytics, automation, digital tools, and innovative audit practices.
* Pilot and implement new methodologies, technologies, and process improvements.
* Contribute to initiatives that enhance audit effectiveness, efficiency, and overall value delivery.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related field.
* Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CA, CISA, or Lean Six Sigma (preferred).
* 8–12 years of Internal Audit experience, with strong exposure to operational audits and audit quality reviews.
* Demonstrated experience in global or matrixed organisations, ideally within FMCG/Consumer Health or comparable industries.
* Strong understanding of IIA Standards, audit methodology, risk assessment, process evaluation, and quality principles.
* Proven ability to lead teams, coach others, and foster a high‑performance culture.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across diverse geographies.
* Comfortable working with ERP systems (SAP/JDE) and analytics/visualisation tools (Power BI desirable).


 The skills for success
   

  

* Data Analytics \& Insights
* Audit \& Risk Management
* Data Extraction \& Transformation
* Data Visualization \& Reporting
* Data Governance \& Quality Management
* Automation \& Continuous Monitoring
* Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication \& Data Storytelling
* Project \& Delivery Management


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word \- it's a way of life!"** 
**Hybrid**
 Description and Requirements
   

  

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 The Control\-M product line is BMC’s orchestration and automation platform. It helps the world's largest companies to automate time\-sensitive, business\-critical workflows. We orchestrate data and machine learning pipelines, supply chains, production lines, financial transactions, and other processes in complex IT environments worldwide. We continuously grow by adding and implementing the most cutting\-edge technologies, conducting innovative Just Do It marathons, thinking about new features to add and investing in our employee training programs!
   

  

**Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC’s and your own success:**
* Product Engineering (Primary Focus) – Design, build, and iterate on core components of a data automation and data management platform across the full stack, taking features from concept through production in a 0–1 product environment.
* Hands\-on Development – Spend most of your time writing high\-quality, production\-ready code across the stack, including backend development (primarily Java and Python) and frontend development ReactJS (latest versions), reviewing pull requests, and improving existing systems with a strong bias toward simplicity, maintainability, and delivery.
* Technical \& Architecture Collaboration – Work alongside the product architect to contribute to system design discussions, define full\-stack architecture, evaluate trade\-offs, and evolve the technical direction as the product matures and real customer constraints emerge.
* Data Platform Capabilities – Implement platform capabilities such as data orchestration, data lineage, observability, governance, and resilience, with a practical understanding of how enterprise customers operate and scale data platforms.
* Integration \& Cloud Enablement – Build and maintain integrations across frontend and backend with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise systems to support automation, deployment, and real\-world customer environments.
* Engineering Practices – Contribute to pragmatic engineering standards across the full stack, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality practices, and DevOps methodologies suitable for a fast\-moving, early\-stage product team.
* Product Collaboration – Partner closely with product management, designers, and stakeholders to translate product requirements into end\-to\-end working software, provide implementation feedback, and support rapid learning from customer feedback.
* Ownership \& Execution – Take end\-to\-end ownership of features and subsystems across frontend and backend, proactively identifying gaps, resolving complex technical challenges, and driving work forward even when requirements are incomplete or evolving.


**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:**
* You have at least 5 plus years of Java development experience
* You worked in a multi\-threaded server\-side environment
* You have experience with Backend Server development on Windows \& UNIX platforms
* You have experience with relational database (Oracle, PGSQL, MSSQL)
* You have good technical and analytical skills
* You are a team player with effective communication skills


**Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills**
* Microservice architecture
* AWS (Kafka, SQS, STS)
* C/C\+\+ and Python
* Spring, Sprint boot
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Maven/Git/Continuous integration


 CA\-DNP
   

  

**Our commitment to you!**
 BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!
   

  

 If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!
   

  

 BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.
   

  

 BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.
   

  

 At BMC we believe in pay transparency and have set the midpoint of the salary band for this role at INR. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
   

  

 The salary listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.
   

  

 (

 )

**Who We Are**
 Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com
   

  

**The role**
 We’re looking for a hardworking, success\-oriented team player who knows the ins and outs of data and can work in a fast\-paced environment. If you’re constantly researching new and exciting uses of technology, we want to talk to you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive innovations by keeping current on emerging cloud technologies
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert for migrating on\-prem applications to cloud\-based PaaS, focusing on data warehouse and big data solutions.
* Architect end\-to\-end data solutions, including data collection
* and storage, data modelling, and data consumption.
* Provide guidance in the migration and transfer of multi\-terabyte databases or data warehouses from one data\-tier technology to another, based on enterprise strategy.
* Data Modelling: Expertise in data modelling techniques and tools, such as ER modelling and dimensional modelling. Design conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts, including source\-to\-target mappings, transforms, and data lineage.
* Partner with Application Architects to design data\-intensive applications with APIs and streaming data pipelines.
* Design solutions to prepare and transform data into a usable state for multi\-platform consumption.
* Create data architecture, engineering and migration patterns for MSSQL, MYSQL, Oracle, Postgres, assisting data tier migrations with multiple technologies, including NoSQL, Relational, Analytical, Big Data, Key Value Data Stores, Data Warehousing, supporting Solera Technology Standards and Strategies (TSS) and Cloud Technology Mapping for software versions, licensing, cost savings and implementation in AWS


**What You'll Bring**
* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of our data engineering infrastructure
* Architect and implement scalable data pipelines for batch and real\-time processing
* Establish best practices, coding standards, and technical documentation
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements
* Optimize data models and database designs for performance and reliability
* Implement data quality controls and monitoring systems
* Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools
* Deploy and manage cloud\-based data solutions (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Ensure data security, compliance, and governance standards are met


**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (Master's preferred)
* 12\+/15\+ years of experience in data engineering roles
* 5\+ years of experience in a technical leadership position
* Utilising Real\-Time, Batch, and NoSQL/SQL technologies.
* Proficiency in data warehousing, data modelling, ETL design, and optimization
* Deep understanding of data enrichment, transformation, security, movement, data architecture, golden record, and data integrity.
* Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Trino, Hive, Iceberg)
* Experience with any data orchestration tools (Airflow, Luigi, etc.)


**GenAI** 
**:**
* Hands\-on work in GenAI over the last 1–3 years, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, orchestration frameworks, and inference optimization.
* Familiarity with AWS migration services like Database Migration Service (DMS) and Server Migration Service (SMS).


**Technical Skills**
* Programming Languages: Python, SQL, Java/Scala
* Big Data Technologies: Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Hive, Trino
* Any Cloud Platforms(AWS preferred):
* AWS (S3, EC2, RDS, Lambda, DynamoDB, Glue)
* Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks)
* GCP (Big Query, Dataflow, Dataproc)
* Data Warehousing: Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query, Fabric Data Warehouse
* Any ETL/ELT Tools: Airflow, dbt, Informatica, Talend, Glue
* Hands\-on with GenAI
* Databases:
* Relational: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle
* NoSQL: MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB
* Time\-series: Influx DB, Timescale DB
* Container \& Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
* Version Control: Git, GitLab/GitHub workflows
* CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI


**Data Architecture Skills**
* Data modelling (dimensional, relational, NoSQL)
* Database design and optimization
* Batch and real\-time pipeline architecture
* Data mesh/data fabric architectures
* Data lake and Lakehouse implementation
* Understanding of API design and development and Microservices architecture is a plus

Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**How will you make an impact?**


Join a team of digital content professionals dedicated to improving how scientists discover and engage with our products and solutions. As a **Scientific Digital Content Writer**, you will apply your scientific background and digital expertise to create clear, accurate, and high\-performing content that supports our customers across the buyer journey.


In this role, you will contribute to content strategy and execution by developing and optimizing web content using SEO and AI\-assisted methodologies. You will help ensure content is structured, discoverable, and aligned with user intent, while maintaining the highest standards of scientific accuracy and quality.


You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners, incorporate subject matter expertise, and use performance insights to continuously improve content effectiveness. This role requires a proactive, detail\-oriented individual who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and is motivated to learn and apply new tools and processes that drive efficiency and scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct keyword, topic, and intent research to identify opportunities to drive qualified traffic and engagement
* Develop, write, edit, and optimize scientific and marketing content for web and digital channels
* Apply SEO and AEO best practices to improve content discoverability and performance
* Evaluate existing content to identify duplication, gaps, and optimization opportunities; recommend and implement improvements
* Structure content using clear hierarchies, taxonomy, and internal linking to enhance user experience
* Participate in peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to support content quality and consistency
* Partner with SEO specialists, marketers, and digital teams to support aligned content strategies and initiatives
* Analyze content performance using analytics tools and apply insights to improve results
* Support the adoption of new content workflows, tools, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in biology or related life sciences field required
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred

**Experience**

* Experience in a life sciences field (e.g., research, R\&D, marketing, technical support, or related)
* Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills
* Experience writing scientific, technical, or marketing content for digital platforms preferred
* Experience working in a matrixed or global organization preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated understanding of SEO and emerging AEO principles, with the ability to apply best practices
* Experience using analytics and SEO tools (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush or similar)
* Knowledge of content strategy fundamentals, including information architecture, taxonomy, and user experience
* Comfort using AI\-enabled tools to enhance content creation, optimization, and workflow efficiency (no development required)
* Ability to evaluate and refine AI\-assisted outputs to ensure scientific accuracy and content quality
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with attention to detail
* Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross\-functional teams
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Ads is a multi\-billion dollar global business that delivers advertising experiences across Amazon's owned\-and\-operated properties (including Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV, and Amazon.com), third\-party publisher networks, and emerging channels like generative AI\-powered shopping experiences. As one of the fastest\-growing segments of Amazon, we operate at unprecedented scale across desktop, mobile, connected TV, and emerging surfaces.
   

  

 Within Amazon Ads, Traffic Quality is a critical pillar of advertiser trust and marketplace integrity. Our mission is to build advanced capabilities that work at petabyte scale to detect sophisticated invalid traffic (IVT) which includes sophisticated non\-human traffic, bot networks, and fraudulent engagement patterns across programmatic advertising. We are on a journey to establish Amazon Ads as an industry leader in traffic quality standards and transparency. Our research agenda focuses on staying ahead of adversarial actors through continuous innovation in detection methodologies, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art techniques in deep learning and generative modeling, user behavior and multi\-modal representation learning, anomaly detection, time\-series analysis, and sparse labeling methods. We process billions of ad events daily, developing novel algorithms that balance precision and recall while operating under strict latency constraints. Our work directly protects hundreds of millions of dollars in advertiser spend annually while maintaining a seamless user experience.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Data Scientist II in Traffic Quality, you will solve inherently hard problems in advertising fraud detection by applying advanced statistical techniques and machine learning. You'll work on systems that process billions of ad impressions and clicks per day, using Amazon's cloud services including EC2, S3, EMR, Sagemaker, and RedShift.
   

  

* Define and frame new research problems in fraud detection where neither problem nor solution is well\-defined.
* Apply new machine learning approaches, models, and algorithms to detect sophisticated invalid traffic.
* Apply domain knowledge to perform broad data analysis as a precursor to modeling and build business insights.
* Work with unstructured and massive datasets to deliver results.
* Produce research reports meeting top\-tier external publication standards.
* Mentor and develop junior scientists on the team.


**About The Team**
 Here are a few papers published by the team:
   

  

 1/ \[Scaling Generative Pre\-training for User Ad Activity Sequences. AdKDD 2023\.](https://assets.amazon.science/b7/42/03be071743d5a57cb1656e6caa34/scaling\-generative\-pre\-training\-for\-user\-ad\-activity\-sequences.pdf)
   

  

 2/ \[SLIDR: Real\-time Robot Detection On Online Ads, IAAI 2023, Deployed Highly Innovative Applications of AI Track (AAAI 2023\)](https://assets.amazon.science/75/2f/3b7106b143f38f7f4d2806388ace/real\-time\-detection\-of\-robotic\-traffic\-in\-online\-advertising.pdf)
   

  

 3/ \[Self\-supervised Representation Learning Across Sequential and Tabular Features Using Transformers, NeurIPS 2022, First Table Representation Learning Workshop](https://openreview.net/forum?id\=wIIJlmr1Dsk)
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of data scientist experience
* 3\+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 3\+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
* 1\+ years of guiding and coaching a group of researchers experience
* 1\+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
* 1\+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
* Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem\-solving
* Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
* Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
* Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
* Experience working on multi\-team, cross\-disciplinary projects
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data\-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

description:
**Role\- Lead Operations Research Scientist – Supply Chain Network Optimization**

**Target**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**About the Team**


Supply Chain Network Optimization (SCNO) is a global team and part of Integrated Operations Planning \& Network steering within Global Supply Chain and Logistics. We are at the forefront of defining and enabling an efficient, reliable and best in class supply chain. This team uses a wide variety of engineering and advanced applied mathematical techniques (5Why’s, ML, AI, OR, MILP, DES,) techniques to study and solve niche problems in supply chain across the entire value chain (Planning, purchasing, transportation, multi echelon inventory, last mile and process optimization) to enable the best guest experience and profitable growth for Target.

**About the Role**


As a Lead Operations Research Scientist in SCNO, you will tackle complex supply chain challenges, develop a deep understanding of problem complexity, and drive cutting\-edge solutions. This role requires strong experience working with large data sets, advanced programming skills, and a solid foundation in statistics, probability theory, machine learning, AI, simulations (such as Monte Carlo and discrete event simulation), and operations research.


You will be expected to work effectively on high\-visibility problems that come with inherent risks, roadblocks, and constraints, while collaborating closely with cross\-functional stakeholders. You will also be accountable for planning and delivering team projects, ensuring alignment across teams, and driving measurable impact.


Key responsibilities include:

* Identify large scale problem spaces aligned to enterprise priorities. Actively engage with cross\-functional business stakeholders to structure the ambiguous problems.
* Work with \& guide junior researchers to gather, analyze, and process large data sets to identify problems and root causes.
* Develop and apply advanced operations research techniques, applied AI, and machine learning methods to solve multi\-dimensional business problems.
* Build and run complex simulations, conduct scenario analyses, and employ optimization methods.
* Plan and develop project charters with clearly defined milestones and success metrics.
* Build cross\-functional alignment, remove blockers to accelerate project delivery.
* Communicate insights effectively through clear and concise storytelling to influence decision\-making.


Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About You**

* Retail or Supply Chain experience is **a must have**.
* **12\+ years** of professional experience with a master’s degree or 8\+ years for a PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics or Statistics. 1\-2 yrs experience in **Applied AI is an advantage**.
* **8\+ years** of experience applying advanced data science and operations research techniques.
* 6\+ years of experience with programming in Python, PySpark and open\-source data science tools.
* Strong problem structuring and solving skills with the ability to address business challenges creatively.
* Team\-oriented with the ability to collaborate effectively across locations and time zones.
* Passionate about continuous learning and empirical research, with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing a team of 3\-4 OR/Data scientists is a plus.

**Why Work with Us at Target?**

* Work on advanced analytics and data science initiatives that directly impact Target’s value chain, including planning \& purchasing strategies, inventory planning, transportation efficiency, and 4\-walls optimization.
* We support your professional growth through learning and development opportunities.
* We value diversity and inclusion, fostering an environment that contributes to positive customer experiences.
* We offer flexible work schedules and arrangements, allowing team members to succeed both at work and in their personal lives in a hybrid setting.

**Useful Links to Learn More About Target and Our Benefits**

* Life at Target: https://india.target.com/
* Benefits: https://india.target.com/life\-at\-target/workplace/benefits

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, and detail\-oriented individual to join our Financial and Regulatory Reporting (FinR) team as Senior Analyst/ Manager, based out of the firm’s offices in Hyderabad/Gurugram/Bengaluru. The team handles the firm’s investor and legal entity financial reporting for its hedge fund and private fund vehicles within the Financial Operations group. The role offers the opportunity to join a collegial and dynamic working environment as part of a highly skilled team, and to work with senior leaders at the firm while assuming considerable responsibility.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY** 
 :
   

  

 In this role, you will prepare, analyze, and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements; conduct account and performance analyses; and handle investor management and regulatory reporting for multiple legal entities in global capital markets. You will be responsible for handling change management processes while understanding and analyzing changes in the firm’s businesses and incorporating these changes into the firm’s financial reporting infrastructure. You will stay up to date on all developments taking place in the technical accounting space (primarily U.S. GAAP) to provide accounting guidance at the firm. You will contribute to adopting new accounting standards, preparing, and reviewing various accounting policy memorandums, and updating and maintaining the firm’s accounting policy manual. You will also contribute to the launch of new funds and closure of existing funds, which may require participation in the structuring of complex fund structures and transactions, conducting historical analyses and fielding other bespoke requests from various internal groups (including senior management and technical investing groups). In addition to this, you will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex fund structures and transactions while interacting substantially with our external auditors and other internal departments, including trade accounting, management company accounting, pricing, investor relations, tax, treasury, legal and compliance, and software development groups.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification (CFA would be an added advantage) with 2\-10 years of relevant work experience in financial reporting for global investment or banking entities handling audits and ensuring statutory compliances under U.S. GAAP
* Technical understanding of investment accounting, including fixed income securities, complex/exotic derivative products, tax\-lot relief methodologies, amortization, corporate actions, alternative investments, securitizations, and other investment products
* Experience with portfolio accounting and management systems
* Attention to detail, keen analytical skills, proficiency in MS Excel, and excellent written and verbal communication skills to successfully interact with various stakeholders
* Robust project management and critical thinking skills with a proactive approach
* The ability to handle all levels of complexity in the respective area of operation while being comfortable functioning in an agile environment with deadlines


 Preferred qualification:
   

  

* Prior experience in the hedge fund or investment banking industries including fund accounting and reporting


 Interested candidates can apply through our website:
   

  

 https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/SnrFinRRepMCAFeb2026
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

description:
**About Reaviva Holistic Health** 




  





 Reaviva Holistic Health is a premium, science led wellness sanctuary in Santacruz West, Mumbai, offering integrated solutions across aesthetics, fitness, recovery, nutrition and mental well\-being. We are committed to personalised care and an exceptional client experience in a sophisticated environment.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for an Associate Sales Manager to own client conversion at the clinic. You will work the enquiry pipeline across telephone, WhatsApp and digital channels, qualify every lead, and convert enquiries into booked consultations and consultations into treatment packages.
 



  





 This is a client facing position at the centre of the business. You will carry an individual revenue target, and you will also be the first point of contact for clients arriving at the clinic, managing the appointment book and the client experience alongside your pipeline. The role suits someone equally confident receiving a client in person and closing a package on the telephone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Place outbound calls to new leads within the agreed response time, and complete the full follow up cadence for enquiries that do not connect at the first attempt
 



 2\. Respond to enquiries across calls, WhatsApp and direct messages, progressing the pipeline through the working day
 



 3\. Manage incoming calls and walk in enquiries with the same qualification discipline applied to digital leads
 



 4\. Qualify enquiries through structured discovery and convert them into booked consultations
 



 5\. Improve the booked to attended ratio through timely reminders, rapport building and pre consultation preparation
 



 6\. Prepare clients ahead of their consultation and hand over to the clinical team with complete context, so that every consultation begins informed
 



 7\. Introduce complementary services where relevant to the client, and book consultations for the clinical team to advise and recommend
 



 8\. Conduct structured reach out campaigns to dormant client segments and contribute to monthly reactivation revenue
 



 9\. Record every client interaction, update enquiry stages promptly, and maintain database accuracy to the required standard
 



  





 Client experience at the clinic
 



  





 10\. Receive clients on arrival with the warmth and polish of a luxury wellness environment, manage the appointment book, and keep waiting times minimal and clearly communicated
 



 11\. Process billing and payments accurately, and record every amount received against the correct client, service and package
 



 12\. Coordinate between clients, therapists and doctors so that each day runs to schedule and every transition between services is seamless
 



 13\. Operate the clinic management system accurately and in real time across appointments, client records, billing and packages
 



 14\. Maintain the reception area, displays and client facing materials to the standard of the brand
 



 15\. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected of a premium clinical environment
 



  





 Performance and standards
 



  





 16\. Submit a daily performance update and participate in weekly funnel reviews with the sales team
 



 17\. Deliver against monthly performance targets covering revenue contribution, enquiry connection, qualification, consultation bookings, attendance rate, walk in conversion and database reactivation
 



 18\. Represent Reaviva in a manner that is informed, courteous and consultative at all times
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Two to four years in a client facing sales role within luxury services, wellness, aesthetics, hospitality or premium retail
 



  





 A record of carrying an individual revenue target, supported by specific examples of what was achieved and how
 



  





 Hands on working experience with an operational clinic, spa or salon management system such as Zenoti, covering appointment scheduling, client records, billing and package management. Working knowledge of a sales CRM is a further advantage
 



  





 Excellent spoken English, delivered with clarity, warmth and conviction
 



  





 Excellent written communication in English across WhatsApp and email, together with correct telephone etiquette
 



  





 A consultative approach to selling, based on establishing trust rather than applying pressure
 



  





 Willingness to work at the clinic and in front of clients for the full working day
 



  





 The ability to manage concurrent responsibilities, attending to a client in person while progressing follow ups, without compromising either
 



  





 Accuracy and discipline in billing, cash handling and record keeping
 



  





 A composed and presentable manner, particularly at times of high footfall
 



  





 A structured approach to problem solving where process is still being established
 



  





 Resilience and consistency in a target led environment with weekly reporting
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Client servicing or guest relations experience in a premium hotel, spa or clinic, followed by a move into a selling role, is the strongest background for this position. Candidates from luxury brands, wellness, beauty or aesthetics are equally encouraged to apply, and prior exposure to high net worth clientele in a service led environment will be considered a significant advantage. Candidates whose experience is limited to telephone based inside sales may find this position less suitable.
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 A front line position in a growing premium wellness brand, with ownership of the client experience from first contact to closed package
 



  





 A monthly incentive linked to revenue, in addition to fixed compensation
 



  





 A defined progression path to senior and leadership positions for consistent performers
 



  





 A collaborative working environment with direct access to leadership
 



  





 Additional Details
 



  





 Location: Santacruz West, Linking Road, Mumbai
 



  





 Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





 Working Pattern: Full time and on site, six days a week with one weekly off on rotation. The clinic is open all days
 



  





 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





 Compensation: Discussed at interview
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Please apply through LinkedIn with your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on site discussion.

description:
**Job Description**
 The
 **Consultant – Project Controls (P2\)** 
 will support the delivery of
 **PMO and project controls services** 
 across UK\&I Transport \& Infrastructure projects, with a focus on
 **project setup, budget setup, task order management, ERP/Horizon data management, cost and performance reporting, governance, and project controls coordination** 
 .
   

  

 The role will work closely with
 **Project Managers, PMO Leads, Project Controls teams, Commercial teams, and Senior/Principal Consultants** 
 to ensure projects are set up correctly, monitored effectively, and reported consistently in line with PMO standards and UK project requirements.
   

  

 While knowledge of planning and scheduling is beneficial, the core focus of this role is
 **project controls, financial governance, ERP data accuracy, reporting, and PMO coordination** 
 .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Project Setup \& Mobilisation Support
* Support project setup activities in Horizon / ERP systems or equivalent project management platforms.
* Assist with creation and maintenance of project structures, including: Project codes, Work Breakdown Structures / task structures, Cost centres, Budget lines, Task orders / work orders
* Ensure project setup aligns with approved scope, contract requirements, financial governance, and PMO standards.
* Support mobilisation activities for new projects, including setup of reporting trackers, governance templates, and project controls documentation.
* Coordinate with PMs and functional teams to ensure project information is complete, accurate, and ready for delivery.
* Budget Setup \& Financial Tracking
* Support budget setup and baseline configuration within Horizon / ERP systems.
* Assist with tracking of approved budgets, forecasts, commitments, and cost movements.
* Support updates to budgets and financial structures where scope, task orders, or project requirements change.
* Help maintain alignment between project budgets, task orders, cost reporting, and financial forecasts.
* Support project teams in monitoring cost performance and identifying variances.
* Task Order / Work Order Management
* Support setup, tracking, and maintenance of Task Orders / Work Orders across project lifecycle.
* Assist PMs and Commercial teams in tracking task orders start / end dates, Budget allocation against task orders, Changes or amendments, Close\-out status
* Ensure task order information is accurately reflected in project controls trackers, reports, and ERP systems.
* Highlight inconsistencies or missing information requiring PM / commercial action.
* Project Controls \& Reporting
* Prepare and maintain project controls reports and dashboards covering: Cost performance, Forecasts, Budget status, Task order status, Risk and issue updates, Overall project performance indicators
* Maintain structured datasets, trackers, KPIs, and reporting templates.
* Support preparation of periodic PMO reporting packs for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned to agreed PMO standards.
* Support in Application for Payments (AfPs) and invoicing on a monthly basis.
* ERP / Horizon Data Management
* Use Horizon / ERP systems to support project lifecycle management from setup through delivery and close\-out.
* Maintain accurate project data to support reporting, financial control, invoicing, and governance.
* Extract, validate, reconcile, and analyse ERP data for reporting purposes.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies between ERP systems, trackers, and dashboards.
* Maintain structured and auditable project records.
* Cost, Forecasting \& Performance Monitoring
* Support cost tracking, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring.
+ Assist with inputs for: Estimate at Completion, Forecast updates, Cost variance analysis, Earned Value / performance tracking where applicable

* Monitor trends and highlight risks, variances, and forecast impacts to senior team members.
* Support working capital visibility and project financial performance reporting.
* Risk, Issue \& Change Support
* Support the maintenance of risk, issue, and action registers.
* Track updates, owners, due dates, and escalation requirements.
* Assist in capturing commercial or delivery\-related impacts arising from changes.
* Ensure changes are reflected in reporting outputs and coordinated with relevant PMO / commercial teams.
* PMO Coordination \& Governance
* Work closely with PMO, Project Managers, Commercial teams, and Project Controls teams to ensure aligned project information.
* Support compliance with PMO frameworks, templates, reporting cycles, and governance requirements.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for key project controls activities.
* Support continuous improvement of PMO processes, trackers, and reporting approaches.
* Planning \& Scheduling
* Maintain a basic understanding of planning and scheduling concepts.
* Ability to interpret schedule inputs for reporting purposes where required.
* Coordinate with planning teams to obtain schedule updates and progress inputs.
* Knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project is beneficial but not mandatory.


**Technical Requirements**
* Strong proficiency in:
+ Advanced MS Excel
+ Power Query

* Working knowledge of:
+ Project controls principles
+ Cost tracking and forecasting
+ ERP/project lifecycle data management
+ Reporting and governance processes

* Experience using or supporting ERP/project systems such as: Horizon / SAP, Ecosys or similar project / financial management systems
* Exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools is desirable.
* Basic familiarity with Primavera P6 / Microsoft Project is desirable.


**Qualifications**
**Experience \& Qualifications**
**Essential**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
* Master’s degree in Project Management or Construction Management.
* 5–8 years of experience in project controls, PMO, project support, or project reporting roles.
* Experience working in a professional services, engineering, infrastructure, or consultancy environment.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to manage structured project data.


**Desirable**
* Exposure to UK Transport \& Infrastructure projects, including Rail, Roads, Civils, Water or Intelligent Infrastructure.
* Experience working in a GCC / offshore delivery model.
* Familiarity with PMO governance frameworks and reporting standards.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, or dashboarding tools.
* Professional certifications/qualification such as:
+ PMP / CAPM
+ APM PFQ / PMQ
+ Relevant project controls or project management certifications.

description:
**Work Schedule**

**Environmental Conditions**

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions for bioprocessing, industrial automation, instrumentation, and process applications.
* Develop reusable software components, backend services, REST APIs, integration layers, data pipelines, libraries, and reference architectures for use across multiple products and programs.
* Integrate software applications with equipment, instruments, PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES, sensors, actuators, and enterprise/manufacturing systems using industrial communication technologies.
* Design solutions for acquisition, processing, storage, visualization, and analysis of equipment, sensor, process, operational, and time\-series data.
* Drive software engineering best practices including object\-oriented design, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, DevOps, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure software solutions address cybersecurity, data integrity, validation, software quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements for connected and regulated systems.
* Identify and implement practical AI/ML, Generative AI, and advanced analytics opportunities for process monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive maintenance, troubleshooting, engineering productivity, knowledge retrieval, and decision support.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture guidance, design reviews, technology evaluation, mentoring, troubleshooting, and technical decision\-making.
* Lead solutions from architecture and proof\-of\-concept through productization, testing, deployment, and lifecycle support while driving reuse, standardization, automation, and engineering productivity


**Required Qualifications**
* 9–14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, industrial/process automation, electronics or electrical engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong hands\-on development experience in one or more languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, object\-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, networking, APIs, data structures, system integration, and scalable application design.
* Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, data pipelines, and applications using relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of industrial/process automation, process control, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, control loops, process variables, and data acquisition.
* Working knowledge of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES and industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or MQTT.
* Experience with automated testing, source control, CI/CD, build automation, deployment, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong architecture, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business and product requirements into secure and scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI, including anomaly detection, predictive analytics, LLMs, RAG, intelligent assistants, AI governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience in bioprocessing, life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, laboratory/instrumentation products, or process industries is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, PAT, APC, soft sensors, digital twins, or model\-based approaches is an advantage.

**Description**
 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
   

  

 We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
   

  

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
   

  

 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
   

  

 We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues.
