description:
**Description**
 We are looking for a Systems Engineer to join the CIPM AUX Engineering team and own the technical execution layer of our power infrastructure lifecycle program. This is an embedded engineering role within a product management team; you will be the technical hands and eyes of the auxiliary power space, working alongside the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) who coordinates and owns the overall program.
   

  

 You will lead lab testing and validation of UPS systems, PDUs, and energy management platforms; execute and support pilot deployments at corporate office sites; create and maintain deployment runbooks, firmware control documentation, and RMA processes; and track the health, compliance, and configuration integrity of the production AUX fleet. You will consult on power requirements for Core Network and Compute hardware, evaluate new auxiliary platforms and management software, and ensure that all products meet CIS standards before handover to delivery teams.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of hands\-on power infrastructure work and structured program execution, and who wants to grow their impact in a team that directly shapes energy management strategy at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Fleet Lifecycle \& Health Supervision
   

  

* Review quarterly all production Golden Configs (GC)
* Review quarterly firmware status for AUX fleet
* Review quarterly product catalog and runbooks
* Warranty monitoring and troubleshooting
* Coordinate firmware patching schedule with site teams
* Provide Tier\-3 on\-call support for technically complex AUX issues
* Manage ticket queue of technical product issues or documentation updates
* Log defects in tracker; warranty deployments to confirm process is self\-service


 Lab Testing \& Pilot Execution
   

  

* Lead lab proof of concept testing for new UPS/PDU platforms and management software
* Review new product pilot requirements
* Pilot site execution — shadow and reverse shadow deployments
* Conduct training sessions for OID on AUX deployment procedures
* Shadow/reverse shadow knowledge transfer for new UPS/PDU products
* Create and deliver Lunch \& Learn sessions for new auxiliary device standards
* Adhere to CIS standards (develop runbook, coordinate initial integration with SBA and internal tooling)
* Review lab changes, track AUX inventory, propose infrastructure changes to support testing
* Track proof of concept hardware (AUX, Core, Compute) installation and testing requirements


 Technical Documentation
   

  

* Build deployment runbooks (create, validate, iterate)
* Build migration/LCR runbooks (create, validate, iterate)
* Build maintenance and service tracking runbook
* Update monitoring runbook for new products
* Update firmware control document for CVE remediation
* Develop RMA process for auxiliary devices
* Define, test, and release password management process
* Maintain comprehensive tracking of configuration changes within corporate asset management and EMS platforms
* Maintain comprehensive process to track maintenance and incidents
* Test and implement process improvements or technology upgrades to enhance power reliability and operational efficiency


 Technical Design \& Standards Ownership
   

  

* Define and validate technical designs for compute infrastructure deployments
* Validate Bill of Materials (BoM) specifications against site and service requirements
* Help defining hardware configuration tiers to serve multiple customer profiles and budget constraints
* Support vendor evaluation and platform certification efforts, including technical validation of alternative compute platforms


 Automation \& Tooling
   

  

* Test, review, and approve automation processes for AUX infrastructure
* Automation review and testing for deployment and maintenance workflows


 Post\-Deployment Supervision \& Knowledge Transfer
   

  

* Warranty monitoring, troubleshooting, and validation
* On\-call for Tier\-3 issues
* Manage ticket queue of technical product issues or documentation updates
* Coordinate firmware patching schedule with site teams
* Warranty deployments to confirm process is self\-service
* Log defects in tracker


**About The Team**
 Corporate Infrastructure Product Management (CIPM) is responsible for the hardware fleet lifecycle of Amazon's corporate infrastructure, encompassing vendor and platform strategy, firmware and patching compliance, fleet inventory and lifecycle management, and hardware capacity planning. CIPM serves as both product owner and strategic driver of the infrastructure hardware roadmap, collaborating closely with partner engineering and deployment teams across the organization.
   

  

 Within CIPM, the Auxiliary (AUX) Engineering function owns the power distribution and energy management layer that underpins all corporate office infrastructure. The team manages a global fleet of auxiliary power hardware — including UPS systems, PDUs, and environment sensors — across corporate office sites worldwide. This fleet provides reliable, efficient power distribution and power supply to every CIS\-hosted product deployed in corporate offices, covering new builds, lifecycle replacements (LCR), expansions, maintenance, and proof of concept programs. The team onboards new auxiliary products through a repeatable process and validates them against CIS standards and site\-specific requirements, ensuring consistent power reliability at Amazon scale.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of systems engineering experience
* Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
* Experience in data center, networking engineering, systems engineering or construction management with a good understanding of data center technologies such as power, cooling and controls systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
* Experience with enterprise UPS/PDU platforms from major manufacturers (APC/Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, or equivalent)

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above\-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client\-centric communication.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* A client\-first attitude, always seeking to create positive client experiences.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or equivalent work experience.

We strive to build and enhance mechanisms to enable publishers and authors create eBooks with the right layouts, typography and fonts for a great and coherent experience across devices.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager (Technical), you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap with the goal of earning the trust of our publishers and authors to deliver the best experience for our reading customers. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group. You will develop and look after product roadmaps and features based on team strategy and vision. This role is inherently cross\-functional \-\- you will work closely with engineering, business, operations, vendor management and executive teams to launch features and build tools and mechanisms. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high quality, simple product, features and applications.

* Assist in driving and delivering the best content experience on all Kindle surfaces.
* Lead cross\-functional teams (engineering, UX, research, etc.) across Amazon and Books to deliver projects on time.
* Support in defining strategic, creative, high quality product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision supported by internal and external analysis.
* Learn from customer feedback, behavioral measurements, and other data sources to craft better experiences and ensure we are building the right features over time.
* Role is global in nature and will work with teams in other countries.

 The KINEX (Kindle Experience) team owns the overall experience for the Kindle for iOS app, Kindle for Android app, FireOS, E\-reader, Kindle for web, PC/Mac, Kindle File Format for Books \& Documents, Content Experiences and Publisher Tools. This includes much of the experience you see on the app (Library, Home, Settings, Insights, etc.) and inside of the book (Core content presentation, Audio books consumption, Aa menu, other chrome), but does not include Store detail page/search and the publishing and subscription side of the business (KDP, KU, etc.).

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budgets.
   

  

 Driving costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
   

  

 Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
   

  

 Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
   

  

 Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests. \- Total project quality including the assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight of the execution of the project.
   

  

 Management of multiple stakeholders and driving the project from starting to successful handing over.
   

  

 Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
   

  

 Recording and reporting key metrics to team members and management.
   

  

 Concurrently managing multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
   

  

 Operational support of installed facilities including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
   

  

 Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
   

  

 Travel to data center sites for electrical systems audits, mechanical system reviews, construct ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Identity Solution team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset
   

  

 As part of an exciting, fast paced environment developing payment authentication and security solutions at Mastercard , this position will provide projects and initiatives delivery management within the development lifecycle for Mastercard ecommerce payment authentication platform.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Using SAFE Agile process, facilitate agile ceremonies / meetings to ensure SCRUM teams remain on track for their committed deliverable for sprints / PI / quarter.
* Facilitate status presentations and reporting to program leadership.
* Coordinates with other teams and participates in the scrum of scrum / Release meetings with Program/Release Train Engineer (RTE).
* This coordinator will work with a cross functional team of technical and business owners to deliver world class solutions to business problems.
* This role is responsible for communication and coordination support to facilitate a self\-organizing and self\-managing teams who can deliver via effective Agile Practices. Help to complete any tasks required to remove impediments for the team and provide coaching and leadership support that make development deliverable possible.

description:
**Description**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 5\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
* Experience presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences in pre\-sales environments
* 5\+ years of experience in any one specific technology domain areas (e.g. AIML, data \& analytics, migration and mordenisation).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10\+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre\-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.

description:
*AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.* 




  





*Do You Dream Big?* 




*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more.
 



  





 We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale \- following Data Mesh and Domain\-Driven Design principles.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat.
 



 Your main mission is to:
 


* Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams.
* Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous.
* Build our Integration\-as\-a\-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud\-native architectures



  





 You’ll work in a cross\-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* **Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* **Discovery \& User\-Centricity**
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* **Roadmap \& Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* **Middleware**
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).



  





**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.



  





**Strong skills in:** 



* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)** 



* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.
* Explicitly call out experience with legacy\-to\-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel\-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog.



  





*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!* 




*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.

description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**  

Nielsen Outcomes empowers advertisers, publishers, and agencies with the intelligence they need to drive revenue, optimize investments, and measure real\-world advertising impact, from brand lift to sales conversion.


We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead our core data processing and analytics platform within the Outcomes product team. This is a high\-autonomy role that requires a balance of technical depth and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for the Data Processing Pillar, with a focus on our brand lift measurement suite. You will serve as the strategic link between client and business needs and technical delivery. You will own the backend pipelines and methodologies that power our measurement products, writing clear specifications for engineering and data science teams while taking hands\-on ownership of backlog refinement, sprint planning, ticket triage, and user acceptance testing.


This position also requires close collaboration with a broad set of stakeholders, including operations and sales teams for project execution, third\-party vendors for data partnerships and integrations, and external clients to onboard their datasets, explain methodologies, and interpret results.


What You’ll Do:


Product Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for our Outcomes Data Processing Pillar, focusing on data ingestion, transformation, and third\-party integrations across our outcomes measurement solutions.
* Independently manage trade\-offs, balancing short\-term client delivery needs with long\-term infrastructure scalability, data governance, and technical debt reduction.
* Monitor industry trends and evolving client needs to keep the product roadmap current, innovative, and competitive.


Technical Execution

* Partner with engineering and data science teams to design processes, databases, and pipelines that support campaign advertising performance datasets.
* Translate complex business needs and client requirements into clear technical specifications, detailed user stories, and actionable acceptance criteria.
* Drive day\-to\-day product delivery: manage the product backlog, refine user stories, plan sprints, and perform user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Regularly collaborate with cross\-functional development teams and product owners to design and deliver platform enhancements and new capabilities.


Stakeholder Alignment \& Client Enablement

* Communicate the product strategy, technical tradeoffs, and results clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership and external clients.
* Work directly with clients to onboard their datasets, explain measurement methodologies, and help interpret project results.
* Lead the roll\-out of new data capabilities and platform features, including user training, documentation, and support, to ensure successful internal and external adoption.
* Build strong, ongoing relationships with internal sales, operations, and customer success teams to understand needs, champion feedback loops, and evolve solutions.

 **Qualifications*** Product \& Industry Experience: **5\+ years in product management, with a significant focus on data platforms, ad tech, or media analytics solutions (**and 8\+ years of total relevant experience in the advertising or media industry).
* **Ad Tech Ecosystem Expertise:** A strong understanding of the digital and TV advertising ecosystem, including ad tagging, audience identity data, and ROI measurement, along with awareness of data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA).
* Measurement Methodologies: Direct experience with broader advertising measurement methodologies, including marketing mix modeling, multi\-touch attribution, or incrementality measurement.
* Analytical \& Technical Fluency: Strong analytical fluency with hands\-on experience querying data warehouses using SQL, and able to understand data architecture, APIs, and platform scalability challenges.
* Data Infrastructure \& Release: Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and data orchestration tools and concepts (e.g. AWS, Azure, Airflow) along with familiarity with technical release patterns and versioning.
* Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and manage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, data science, sales, and operations teams.
* **Agile Practices: Working knowledge of Agile or similar iterative development methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.**
* Autonomy \& Ownership: A natural problem\-solver with a knack for turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable plans.


Preferred Qualifications

* Brand Lift Expertise: Direct experience with panel\-based research, survey methodologies, or brand lift outcome measurement.
* Data Partnerships \& Integrations: Proven background managing third\-party data providers end\-to\-end, from initial discovery through full data onboarding and integration.
* Data Governance: Familiarity with data governance frameworks, privacy\-enhancing technologies, or identity/data clean room solutions.
* Data Science Collaboration: Background in collaborating with data science teams on methodology design and data validation.

 **Additional Information**  

Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

 ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
   

  

 We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, we are looking for an R\&D Engineer – System 800xA \& Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp \& Paper industry.
   

  

 Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end\-to\-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R\&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA \& QCS Research \& Development organization in Bangalore, India.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for**
* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end\-to\-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R\&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high\-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands\-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end\-to\-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
* Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp \& Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131\-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443\), automated testing practices, AI\-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.


**More About Us**
 ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp \& paper, battery manufacturing, food \& beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.
   

  

 Our R\&D organization develops next\-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud\-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced automation technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial operations.

 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**

description:
**Description**
 Are you looking for an opportunity that will help revolutionize the way big data sets are cataloged, discovered and searched for one of the world’s largest financial data systems? Are you interested in innovating and building platforms that use machine learning to identify anomalies and provide insights across billions of financial transactions? Does the prospect of working with the top engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you!
   

  

 Amazon Finance Technology is seeking a talented Software Development Engineer to work on FinTech Treasury. In this role, you will build treasury solutions that manage bank balances, cash flows, and cash\-impacting transactions, supporting financial movements across all Amazon businesses. You will build a next\-generation, horizontally scalable platform that will transact hundreds of billions of dollars each year as Amazon grows into a multi\-trillion\-dollar company. The platform supports banking and financial services capabilities that enable cash flow tracking and payment execution across Amazon’s global operations. You should be comfortable working with highly abstracted, extensible systems in a multi\-tenant, microservice\-oriented architecture.

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.


**About Us:**


Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.


Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.


**Position Summary:**


Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy \& Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional \& Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration \& Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

 **Experience and Skills:**

**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications**:


* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

**Job Description**
 Shape the future of software delivery by building applied artificial intelligence solutions that are secure, reliable, and measurable. Join a team that turns advanced methods into production capabilities used by real customers, with strong engineering standards and clear ownership. Bring your expertise in building distributed systems and grow your impact through high\-visibility work, deep technical leadership, and cross\-team collaboration
   

  

 As an Applied AI ML Lead at JPMorgan Chase, you will architect, build, and operate trusted applied artificial intelligence capabilities used in production. You will partner with product and engineering teams to deliver workflow automation and retrieval\-based solutions that improve user outcomes. You will translate technical tradeoffs across quality, latency, cost, and controls into clear recommendations that accelerate delivery and measurable business impact.
   

  

 In this role, you will focus on production engineering for applied artificial intelligence, including retrieval\-based question answering and tool\-enabled workflow automation. You will set engineering patterns that improve consistency and reuse across teams, while maintaining strong standards for security, access controls, and operational resilience. You will define how solutions are evaluated, monitored, and improved over time based on real usage and measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on role with significant influence through design leadership, reviews, and shared practices.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery for applied artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions, from requirements shaping through production support.
* Architect retrieval‑augmented generation solutions, including data ingestion, content segmentation, embedding, indexing, retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Implement tool\-enabled, agent\-based workflows with orchestration, state management, retries, permissions, guardrails, and observability.
* Define evaluation strategies, including offline test suites, curated datasets, human review where needed, continuous evaluation, and telemetry\-driven monitoring.
* Build reusable engineering patterns and reference implementations that reduce duplication and speed delivery across teams.
* Drive reliability, performance, and cost outcomes through benchmarking, capacity planning, latency optimization, and post\-incident learning.
* Embed security and governance by design, including sensitive\-data\-aware handling, access controls, auditability, and disciplined release practices for models and prompts.
* Influence technical direction through clear design documents, design reviews, and pragmatic decision\-making aligned to partner needs and control requirements.
* Coach peers through pairing, feedback, and best\-practice guidance without direct people management.
* Champion a culture of opportunity, inclusion, and respect in day\-to\-day collaboration.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering and/or data engineering experience delivering production distributed systems.
* Proficiency coding in Python and/or Java, including building, testing, and operating services in production.
* Demonstrated delivery of applied artificial intelligence and/or machine learning solutions to production, including monitoring and iterative improvement based on usage.
* Expertise designing retrieval‑augmented generation architectures, including embedding\-based search, retrieval/indexing, re\-ranking, grounding methods, and quality evaluation.
* Experience building tool\-enabled workflow automation (agent\-based patterns) with orchestration, state management, retries, and safety guardrails.
* Strong data engineering fundamentals, including data quality controls, idempotent pipelines, backfills, and metadata/lineage concepts.
* Experience deploying and operating secure, cloud\-native services on Amazon Web Services, including performance, latency, and cost management.
* Strong communication skills to explain technical tradeoffs and recommendations to product and engineering stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow to partner effectively on training, fine\-tuning, and evaluation.
* Experience automating evaluation and quality gates for applied artificial intelligence systems, including regression testing, continuous evaluation, and versioning for prompts and models.

description:

 : Generative AI Engineer

**Location** 
 : Bangalore, Mumbai \& Trivandrum
 



 Role Summary:
 



 We are seeking a hands\-on and technically strong Generative AI Engineer to AI
 



 Platform Capabilities team as part of the Platform Implementation Partner engagement. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise\-grade Generative AI platform capabilities across four Local Business Units operating on GCP and Azure. Your primary focus will be on closing identified AI platform capability gaps by engineering production\-ready, reusable GenAI components across the full AI stack \- spanning the Decision \& Orchestration Layer (RAG, Agent Orchestration, Semantic Router), the Execution Runtime Layer (LLM Gateway, ML Serving, Tool \& Integration Runtime, Event Bus), and the Build \& Lifecycle Layer (GenAIOps, AgentOps, MLOps).
 



 You will work closely with the Use Case Implementation Partner and LBU Data \& AI teams to ensure that all platform capabilities are built for reuse, comply with enterprise standards, and are delivered within use case timelines across Agency and Operations domains. This is a deeply technical engineering role focused on building and operationalizing platform components, not managing client engagements.
 



  





**Required Skills:** 




 ● Generative AI \& RAG Engineering: Proven, hands\-on experience building production RAG pipelines, including data ingestion, chunking strategy design, embedding selection, vector indexing (e.g., BigQuery Vector Search), retrieval logic, and deployment as API endpoints. Strong understanding of RAG evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision/Recall)
 



 and continuous knowledge base updating pipelines.
 



 ● Agentic Architecture \& Implementation: Demonstrated experience building multi\-agent systems, including Semantic Router, Agent Orchestrator (with workflow management), Stateful Orchestration Runtime (Reasoning Engine), and Session State/Memory (LTM/STM) management. Ability to implement agent\-to\-agent communication protocols, intent recognition, routing
 



 models, and agent handoff mechanisms with summary generation.
 



 ● LLM Gateway \& Execution Runtime: Experience implementing centralized AI/LLM Gateway solutions covering model routing, rate limiting, caching, observability, fallback logic, and policy enforcement across multiple LLM providers. Familiarity with Tool \& Integration Runtime (API calls, MCP, A2A) and Event Bus/Messaging architectures for asynchronous, decoupled AI servicecoordination.
 



 ● GenAIOps \& MLOps Frameworks: Hands\-on experience implementing GenAIOps practices including Prompt Engineering, RAG configuration management, embedding lifecycle management, PEFT/LLM fine\-tuning, Prompt Registry versioning, and LLM evaluation pipelines. Solid understanding of MLOps principles covering model training, validation, experiment tracking,
 



 model registry, serving, monitoring, and explainability.
 



 ● AgentOps Implementation: Experience building and operationalizing AgentOps frameworks for developing, deploying, monitoring, and governing AI agents, including scenario testing, approval gate workflows, memory management, tool call tracking, and latency/success rate monitoring.
 



 ● GCP AI/ML Platform Proficiency: Strong, hands\-on expertise with GCP services critical to AI platform delivery, including Vertex AI (Model Garden, Pipelines, Feature Store, Model Registry), Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery. Ability to deploy GenAI capabilities as scalable, standalone API\-accessible services.
 



 ● Python \& API Development: Strong Python programming skills for building GenAI pipelines, agentic workflows, REST APIs, and automation scripts. Experience deploying AI services as scalable API endpoints with appropriate authentication, rate limiting, and monitoring.
 



 ● AI Safety, Governance \& Compliance: Practical experience implementing AI safety guardrails, output filtering, PII protection, bias detection, and audit logging within GenAI platforms. Understanding of data sovereignty requirements and compliance standards relevant to a regulated financial services environment.
 



 ● CI/CD \& Infrastructure as Code: Experience integrating GenAI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Google Cloud Build) for automated testing, evaluation, and deployment. Working knowledge of Terraform for provisioning GCP\-based AI infrastructure.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have:** 




 ● Experience building AI platform capabilities in a multi\-cloud environment (GCP
 



 and Microsoft Azure), ideally supporting a "build once, leverage everywhere" reusability model across multiple LBUs.
 



 ● Familiarity with the Document Intelligence service (AI\-powered extraction from
 



 PDFs, invoices, and forms) and Agent Marketplace concepts (centralized catalog for versioned, reusable AI agents).
 



 ● Experience with Knowledge Graph architectures integrated with RAG for
 



 enterprise semantic discovery and relationship\-based reasoning.
 



 ● Familiarity with RAG orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and LLM
 



 evaluation toolsets such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or Vertex AI Rapid Eval.
 



 ● Experience with Context Store, Vector Store, Embedding infrastructure, and Store design as components of an AI\-ready data layer.
 



 ● Knowledge of the financial services or insurance (BFSI) domain, including data sovereignty, regulatory compliance, and risk management requirements across APAC markets.
 



 ● Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
 



 ● Experience working within large\-scale enterprise programs involving multiple
 



 implementation partners and formal governance and change management frameworks.

**Description**
 ROW (Rest of World) Network Operations Centre (NOC) sits at the core of the order\-to\-delivery Supply Chain. Under the broader NOC org sites ROW Inbound (ROW IB) which aims to improve reliability, cost\-to\-serve and operator/vendor experience in First Mile operations through standardization, programmatic interventions, exception management and automations. We achieve this through our centralized workstreams on (i) vendor/seller/carrier appointment scheduling (ii) rescue interventions (iii) research workflows and (iv) network monitoring.
   

  

 Responsibilities: We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. This role will lead the centralized MFI (Missing From Inbound) across the network, driving end\-to\-end ticket lifecycle management, SLA adherence, and loss reduction through process standardization and automation. The program manager will partner cross\-functionally with FC operations, MFI PMs, vendor facing teams and tech teams to identify systemic defect patterns, implement scalable resolution workflows, and deliver measurable improvement across multiple countries.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on and motivated self\-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision\-making. They will work with stakeholders from multiple partner team to manage last mile support function \& improve program performance.
   

  

 The manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance \- 4 PM to 2 AM or 1 PM to 10 PM) to cater to multiple ROW geos.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick\-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon facilities and to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings.  

  

In addition to this tactical problem solving, ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  

  

Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* Managing a shift, constantly identifying opportunities to improve team performance and owning associated change management. This is Work from Office position
* Developing and/or referring to performance metrics to drive team performance and business results.
* Identifying the business impact of trends and making data backed decisions. Able to learn and become a SME of the process (where engaged)
* Communicating with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
* Escalating problems or variances in the information and data to the relevant owners and following through on resolutions.
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis, as needed, is a plus.
* Serves as escalation point for transportation specialists.
* Owning process/business level reports/actions and diving compliance..
* Perform Ad\-hoc reporting and analysis as per requirement.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a finance

* Qualified / Semi‑qualified CA, or M.Com / CWA (CMA).
* Experience in corporate finance, shared services, audit firms, or consulting preferred.
